_comment: The pipeline contract: what other code actually reads.
Every rule names its consumer, because that is what makes it a contract
rather than a preference. A rule with no consumer does not belong here --
the documents this replaces claimed several, and enumerating them found
no reader at all for alpha.py, backtest.py, plot.py, the PNG names, the
portfolio parquets, or the frontmatter keys author and revision.
This file is the source of truth. CONTRACT.md is generated from it by
`python ops/pipeline/check.py --emit-doc`, so the two cannot drift -- which
is the failure being fixed: the prose said in bold that status must not be
'success', 'fail' or 'review', while the dashboard accepted all three.

rules.breaks: The dashboard filters on the date prefix. Without it the strategy is never listed.
The dashboard has nothing to show and wikilinks to this directory do not resolve.
A missing key drops the entry from the dashboard listing or the knowledge-base index.
An unrecognised status is dropped from the dashboard filter entirely.
rules.note: The shipped pipelines assert in bold that success/fail/review must NOT be used. That is false: STATUS_ALIASES accepts all thirteen spellings above. The prohibition over-restricts, so obeying it is harmless, but it is not the contract.

rules.breaks: The report panel reports 'No report found'.
The publisher cannot start. A synchronous def fails before the helpful error in call_setup_portfolio and reports something less useful.

Deployment selects alpha files by regex-scraping quoted brain/strategy/... literals out of the source. A literal is found whether it sits at the call site or in a variable; a path composed at runtime (Path(...) / name, os.path.join) matches nothing and that alpha silently does not ship, and an f-string matches the literal text brain/strategy/{name}/alpha.py so the bundler hunts a file that cannot exist.

methodology._comment: Not contract. The user's to change, and saying so matters as much as the list above -- a user who believes every filename is load-bearing will not change the one thing they should.
